SddInterviewProtocol.keywords: interview, coverage-map, triage, amplification, rounds, defaults-first, weak-spots, closure, stakes-split, one-question-per-message, ask-tool-binding, failure-categories, uncomfortable-questions, sdd-interview-protocol
SddInterviewProtocol.Mission:
Run ONE operator interview for an authoring step. Loaded lazily by a branch step (scope STEP_2 / STEP_3, infra STEP_2, interface STEP_2, module STEP_2) via `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE`; the calling step supplies the scope-type + its focus and stays the owner of what gets written. Inherits the router core (language, dialogue, safeguard, diverge, no-narration) — not repeated here.
This protocol equips the interview declared by `AX_OPERATOR_SAFEGUARD` with instruments: a live coverage map, a mandatory failure-category block (`AX_UNCOMFORTABLE_QUESTIONS`), an amplification triage, defaults-first rounds, and a map-based closure criterion. The safeguard axiom stays the source of the interviewing instinct; this directive only gives it structure.
Input — scope-type, calling-step focus, intake gathered so far. Output — a closed coverage map + the captured answers and decisions, returned to the calling step. This directive writes no artifact; control returns to the caller at CLOSE.
**Single-fork fast path.** When the caller hands the protocol exactly one named fork (not a whole authoring step), skip `STEP_1_INIT_MAP` and `STEP_2_TRIAGE`; enter `STEP_3_ROUNDS` with a one-item map (the fork), close it per `AX_STAKES_SPLIT` / `AX_ASK_TOOL_BINDING`, return.

BeliefState.Axiom:
The interview ends when the coverage map is closed — every topic `✅` or explicitly skipped with a recorded reason — never when a question count is reached, and never by a silent Approval Check. After every operator answer, re-check the map: an answer that opens a new hole or risk adds a topic or reopens a closed one (thread-pulling per `AX_OPERATOR_SAFEGUARD` — that axiom owns the instinct; this one binds it to the map). A skip on a high-stakes topic goes through `H_HIGH_STAKES_SKIP`.
`🟡` (partial, `COVERAGE_MAP_FORMAT`) is NEVER read as closed — text the operator already brought (intake, a pasted spec draft, a rich prior message) marks a topic `🟡` at most, never `✅` on the strength of that text alone, no matter how detailed it reads. Only one of two things promotes `🟡` to `✅`: a confirmed answer given IN the dialogue, or an explicit «принято как есть» note the agent records in the spec itself. `STEP_4_CLOSE`-style gates treat `🟡` exactly like `◻️`/`👷` — not closed, sends the flow back to closing rounds.

Where a defensible default exists, lead with it: propose one concrete option drawn from real production practice and ask the operator to confirm or correct — instead of an open question. The default MUST be the result of `AX_DIVERGE_BEFORE_RECOMMEND`, not the first typical answer. Reserve open questions for decisions that are genuinely operator-owned (business goals, risk acceptance, priorities) or where no defensible default exists; open-ended deepening on any topic happens when the operator asks for it.

Amplifications are opt-in: after triage the agent PROPOSES a set from the catalog, the operator confirms; the default for small tasks is «none active». State an empty proposal explicitly — «усиления не нужны, потому что …» — it is a valid triage outcome, not a silent omission. A confirmed amplification becomes a map topic and its directive loads lazily via `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE` at the moment its topic opens, never up front.

Ask only for a decision that is still open. Intake, portal/state output, and an earlier operator answer are binding evidence: carry them forward by reference and never ask the operator to confirm the same value again. A contradiction or genuinely new consequence reopens only the affected decision, with the delta named explicitly.

Every meaningful frame includes ≥1 uncomfortable question — the kind that exposes hidden assumptions, degradation paths, or trust boundaries. Canonical seeds: - What is the canonical source of truth for this entity / capability? - What happens on dependency unavailability (graceful degradation vs hard failure)? - Where does simulation end and real runtime begin? - Who validates input at this trust boundary? - Which assumption, if wrong, invalidates the design?
Skipping uncomfortable questions = false consensus.

The stakes of a question decide its delivery form — this overrides any round-grouping default: - A **развилка** (architecture, a trust boundary, an irreversible or hard-to-undo choice) → ONE question per message, full form per `QUESTION_MESSAGE_FORMAT`, answered via `AskUserQuestion` before the next question is composed. - A **default confirmation** (naming, a low-risk default, an obvious yes/no) → batched, up to 4 per `AskUserQuestion` call, per `BATCH_CONFIRM_FORMAT`. Unsure which it is → treat as развилка. Burying a genuine fork inside a batch is the exact failure this axiom exists to prevent.

Развилки go strictly one at a time: compose question N+1 only after the answer to question N is in. Each next question MUST account for every prior answer in the interview — a question whose premise an earlier answer already invalidated is a protocol defect, not a style issue. The counter in `## Вопрос из ` is owned here: X is this question's ordinal in the interview; Y is questions already asked plus развилки still open on the coverage map. When thread-pulling opens a new topic, Y grows and the growth shows in the next map line — never silently.

Every развилка ends in one `AskUserQuestion` call, bound to its chat message: - The chat message carries the full material (`QUESTION_MESSAGE_FORMAT`); the ASK call carries only short option labels + one-line descriptions — never move the argument itself into the ASK. - Options appear in the ASK in the SAME order they were printed in the message. - A recommendation prints first in the message too (letter A) and carries «(рекомендую)» in its ASK label — printed order and recommended-first then agree. - «Other» is supplied by the tool automatically; never add a manual equivalent. - Tool unavailable → drop only the ASK call; the развилка message still follows `QUESTION_MESSAGE_FORMAT` and the answer arrives as free text, otherwise falling back to `QUESTION_FORMAT`'s plain-text fallback when one applies. Batched default confirmations use one ASK call covering 2–4 questions.

When a question's subject is relational — a flow, a boundary, a structure, a lifecycle, or variants that differ in shape — draw a compact ASCII picture BEFORE the variants, per `formats/diagram-vocabulary.xml` (`AX_DIAGRAM_DISCIPLINE`: ≤7 nodes, one diagram per idea). A question about a single scalar choice stays text; a diagram of one node is noise, not clarity. The same relation later lands in the spec as mermaid — the module/scope Overview if it is the floor diagram (`AX_OVERVIEW_DIAGRAM_FLOOR`), else inline where the section needs it. The chat ASCII is the operator's preview of the shape they are approving.
Two topics are NOT a judgment call — they are always relational and always draw: closing «Потребители» (who consumes + what they expect — actors, ≥1 relation to the scope) and, for `product` scope-type, «Худший сценарий» (the worst plausible scenario) both feed the Use Cases diagram the calling scope step owns (`AX_SPEC_MANDATORY_DIAGRAM` in `scope.directive.xml`) — the caller draws it when these topics close, this axiom does not leave that one to "when it seems relational".

The operator surfs a question message, they do not wade through it: bold marks the load-bearing word inside a bullet, not the whole sentence; each block opens with its own emoji anchor; paragraphs stay ≤3 lines; no monolithic wall of text. Emotion is seasoning, not paint — anchors and an occasional marker, never an emoji on every line.

SddInterviewProtocol.TopicCatalog:
Base topics — every interview starts with these (map labels in Russian):
| Topic | Substance | |---|---| | Цель и не-цель | what this scope delivers; what it explicitly refuses to do in this iteration | | Потребители | who consumes the result and what they expect from it | | Слабые места | MANDATORY: holes, contradictions, unstated expectations of the intake — name them to the operator, per `AX_OPERATOR_SAFEGUARD` | | Внешние зависимости | what outside this scope must exist / hold for the design to stand | | Встраивание в систему | MANDATORY: which existing mechanism this extends (or the cited neighbour invariant that justifies a new one); which neighbour specs and requirements the change touches — closes ONLY from the calling directive's `STEP_*_SYSTEM_FIT` `sdd-orient` output, never from a guess (`AX_PARALLEL_MECHANISM_REQUIRES_JUSTIFICATION`) |
«Встраивание в систему» is answered by the tool, not by agent recall: when the calling directive's `STEP_*_SYSTEM_FIT` already ran before this interview instance, this topic opens pre-closed (`✅`) with a one-line pointer to that step's recorded answers; when `STEP_*_SYSTEM_FIT` runs AFTER this interview instance (later in the same directive's flow), the calling step narrows it out of THIS map — per the narrowing rule below — and it closes directly at that later step instead of inside this loop. Either way this topic never closes on the agent's own inference (`AX_COVERAGE_MAP_CLOSURE`).
scope-type block — append per the caller's scope-type:
| scope-type | Topics | |---|---| | product | Пользователи (who exactly, how many) · Метрика успеха/провала (both, not only success) · Зачем сейчас (why this, why now) · Худший сценарий (the worst plausible scenario and who pays for it) | | library | Разработчики-потребители (which teams / repos) · DX (how consumption should feel; feeds the Usage Example) · Версии (versioning + compatibility promises) | | infrastructure | Окружения (dev / CI / prod parity) · Доставка (how changes reach consumers) | | interface | Стороны контракта (producers and consumers, who owns the schema) · Эволюция (how the contract changes without breaking consumers) |
The calling step MAY narrow or extend the block for its focus (e.g. scope STEP_3 keeps only what the Requirements Gate still misses); «Слабые места» stays on every map.
**Категории отказов** — mandatory on every map, every scope-type, no narrowing. Closed together as ONE combined round, not one topic at a time (the one exception to `STEP_3_ROUNDS`'s usual one-topic-per-round loop):
| Topic | Substance | |---|---| | Негативные сценарии | invalid / empty / duplicate input | | Отказ внешней зависимости | graceful degradation vs a hard failure | | Лимиты и нагрузка | a concrete numeric threshold — rate, volume, concurrency ceiling | | Конкурентность и гонки | concurrent access / race conditions | | Границы доверия | who confirms rights here; what happens when an outsider reaches this |
Rules for this block: - **Budget.** At most 5 questions total across all five categories, spent only on the gaps the intake and prior answers leave open — never one question per category by reflex. More than 5 gaps compete → prioritize by impact × uncertainty and leave the rest `◻️` for a later round, never silently skipped. - **No closure by agent guess.** A category never turns `✅` on the agent's own inference — per `AX_COVERAGE_MAP_CLOSURE`, only a direct operator answer, or an explicit «не применимо, потому что …» the agent records in the spec, closes it. Anything else stays `🟡` at best. - **Delivery form.** ONE `AskUserQuestion` batch of 3–5 independent sub-questions — the five categories are independent of each other, so this is `BATCH_CONFIRM_FORMAT`'s shape, not `QUESTION_MESSAGE_FORMAT`'s one-at-a-time развилка. A second batch is allowed ONLY for a sub-question whose premise depends on an answer just received; cap — two batches for this whole block per spec, never more. - **Closing report.** One line to the operator at the end of this round: what exactly was asked about the off-nominal flow. Criterion per `AX_UNCOMFORTABLE_QUESTIONS`: the happy path is known going into every spec by default — understanding of the actual task shows up in the off-nominal flow instead. No question asked here reads as poor understanding, not as a small scope.
SddInterviewProtocol.AmplificationCatalog:
Deep-dive modules; each is a separate directive authored elsewhere and loaded lazily (`AX_AMPLIFICATION_OPT_IN`):
| Amplification | Directive | Triage trigger | |---|---|---| | security | `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE("ai/directives/sdd-v2/amplify-security.directive.xml")` | external users, or data crossing a trust boundary | | nfr | `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE("ai/directives/sdd-v2/amplify-nfr.directive.xml")` | load / latency / volume significant enough to shape the design | | storage | `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE("ai/directives/sdd-v2/amplify-storage.directive.xml")` | state persisted beyond a single run | | observability | `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE("ai/directives/sdd-v2/amplify-observability.directive.xml")` | someone must diagnose this in production |
SddInterviewProtocol.HaltConditions: | 🛑 ID | Trigger | |---|---| | `H_HIGH_STAKES_SKIP` | Operator insists on skipping an unclosed high-stakes topic — name the concrete cost (per `AX_OPERATOR_SAFEGUARD`); on a confirmed skip record `✗ skip: <причина>` in the map and proceed |

Step.Goal: Build and show the coverage map.
Step.Action: Assemble the map: base topics + «Категории отказов» + the scope-type block from `TopicCatalog`, narrowed / extended by the calling step's focus (не narrow «Категории отказов» — it stays whole on every map). Text the operator already brought (intake, a pasted draft) marks a topic `🟡` (partial) AT MOST — never `✅`; rich, detailed intake text earns no exception (`AX_COVERAGE_MAP_CLOSURE`). Render per `COVERAGE_MAP_FORMAT` with a one-line plan («что осталось закрыть»); proceed straight to triage.

Step.Goal: Decide which amplifications this task deserves.
Step.Action: Evaluate the `AmplificationCatalog` triggers from already-known intake first. Ask one compact closed batch only for triggers whose answer remains unknown; zero unknown triggers means zero Ask. Propose the resulting amplification set with the small-task default «none active» (`AX_AMPLIFICATION_OPT_IN`). A set fully implied by accepted answers is carried forward without a second confirmation (`AX_DELTA_ONLY_ASK`). Confirmed amplifications become map topics on the «Усиления» line.

Step.Goal: Close the map, one topic at a time, in the shape its stakes demand.
Step.Action: Loop until the map is closed (`AX_COVERAGE_MAP_CLOSURE`); each round: 1. Show the map per `COVERAGE_MAP_FORMAT`, pick the next open topic, mark it `👷` — the active topic ALWAYS carries `👷`, never a bare unmark, per `BREADCRUMB_FORMAT`. 2. Split by stakes (`AX_STAKES_SPLIT`): a развилка → one message per `QUESTION_MESSAGE_FORMAT`, answered before the next question is composed (`AX_ONE_QUESTION_SEQUENTIAL`); a default confirmation → collect it and batch up to 4 per `BATCH_CONFIRM_FORMAT`. 3. Shape each question per `AX_DEFAULTS_FIRST` and `AX_DELTA_ONLY_ASK` — a concrete default to confirm or correct — and bind its chat message to the `AskUserQuestion` call per `AX_ASK_TOOL_BINDING`. 4. After each answer, update the map and pull the thread per `AX_COVERAGE_MAP_CLOSURE` (new hole → new / reopened topic; a развилка whose premise the answer invalidated is recomposed, not asked as planned — `AX_ONE_QUESTION_SEQUENTIAL`). 5. An amplification topic opens → `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE` its directive from `AmplificationCatalog` and run its questions as this round, split by stakes the same way. 6. «Категории отказов» opens as ONE combined round, not one topic per loop-pass (the `TopicCatalog` rules for this block override the usual one-topic-at-a-time shape): batch 3–5 independent sub-questions — one per open category — into a single `AskUserQuestion` per `BATCH_CONFIRM_FORMAT`; a second batch only for a sub-question a received answer now depends on (cap two batches, ever, for this block). Budget ≤5 questions total, spent on gaps only; a category with no gap closes `✅` without a question. Per `AX_UNCOMFORTABLE_QUESTIONS`, never let this round pass with zero questions asked when a gap remains — skipping it silently is exactly the false consensus that axiom exists to catch. Close the round with the one-line closing report («что спросили про нештатное»). A skip request on a high-stakes topic → `H_HIGH_STAKES_SKIP`.

Step.Goal: Verify closure and return to the caller.
Step.Action: Gate per `AX_COVERAGE_MAP_CLOSURE`: every topic `✅` or `✗ skip: <причина>` — an open (`◻️`), active (`👷`), or partial (`🟡`) topic sends the flow back to STEP_3. Show the final map + a compact digest of answers and decisions (Russian), including skips with reasons. Hand the digest to the calling step. The digest is evidence, not a new approval surface: the caller asks again only for a newly introduced delta (`AX_DELTA_ONLY_ASK`).

SddInterviewProtocol.ChatOutput:
Explain, then ask through the tool — a question never fires as bare free-form text. A `### 💡 <О чём решаем>` section header names the decision in plain words, without numbering and without semantic question IDs; under it, ordinary language explains the question BEFORE any tool call fires — the context, the real options, and a recommendation gated by `AX_DIVERGE_BEFORE_RECOMMEND` (low-stakes: a direct pick is fine; high-stakes / architecture: do not pre-anchor one option — lay out the strongest candidates, a tail one included, or pair the recommendation with its strongest rival and the reason it might win instead). Only once the explanation stands does `AskUserQuestion` fire; its option list mirrors the printed order, short labels only — the argument itself lives in the message, never moved into the tool call.
Batching rule: one `AskUserQuestion` call may carry several questions ONLY when they are mutually independent — answering one does not change the meaning or the options of another (several facets of one single complex decision qualify as one batched call). Dependent questions, and any interview sequence, go one call at a time: compose the next question only after the previous answer is in.
Channel: use `AskUserQuestion` whenever the tool is available. When it is not, fall back to plain text carrying the same shape — the explanation, then an explicit list of named options the operator can answer by name; skipping the explanation and firing a bare list of options is itself the violation this contract forbids (`H_UNFORMATTED_ASK`).
Low-stakes — a recommendation is allowed, but only as the result of `AX_DIVERGE_BEFORE_RECOMMEND` (not the first typical answer):
Пример — иллюстрация формата, не задание:
### 💡 Куда положить ресёрч-документ Документ можно держать рядом со спекой — виден в контексте скоупа, проще найти, пока читаешь её — или в общем каталоге ресёрчей, если он пригодится за пределами одного скоупа; для разового ресёрча под конкретную спеку разница небольшая. ✅ **Рядом со спекой** `[specs//research/]` — виден в контексте скоупа, не потеряется. Иначе: - **Общий каталог** `[docs/research/]` — _за: виден без привязки к одному скоупу · против: сложнее понять, к какой спеке относится_
(AskUserQuestion: «Рядом со спекой (рекомендую)» · «Общий каталог»)
High-stakes / architecture — do NOT pre-anchor one pick. List the strongest candidates (include a non-obvious / tail one) with «за / против» and let the operator choose; or give a recommendation only alongside its strongest alternative and the reason it might win:
Пример — иллюстрация формата, не задание:
### 💡 Граница нового скоупа Функциональность можно оформить отдельным скоупом или модулем внутри существующего — от этого зависит, где заводить спеку и как считать её границы; пре-анкоринг здесь дороже, чем в низкоставочном случае. - **Отдельный скоуп** `[new-scope]` — _за: чистая граница, не тащит чужие инварианты · против: больше координации между скоупами_ - **Модуль внутри существующего скоупа** `[module-in-scope]` — _за: меньше накладных расходов, общий контекст уже есть · против: граница скоупа расползается со временем_ - **Отложить решение до следующей итерации** `[defer]` — нетипичный вариант, но снимает риск закрепить границу раньше, чем видно реальное использование
(AskUserQuestion: «Отдельный скоуп» · «Модуль внутри существующего» · «Отложить (нетипичный)»)
A plain binary question needs no list — recommendation + inline alternative, still explained before the call:
Пример — иллюстрация формата, не задание:
### 💡 Нужен ли отдельный interface-скоуп Все текущие потребители — web; про API и будущих клиентов явно не говорили. ✅ **Пока не выделять** — можно добавить позже без миграции. _или сразу выделить, если API уже в планах?_
(AskUserQuestion: «Пока не выделять (рекомендую)» · «Выделить сразу»)
A counter-question in reply to a gate is a side-dive, not a rejection: (a) answer the counter-question in full, on its own merits, before returning to the gate; (b) bring the gate back exactly once, marked as a repeat pass, enriched with whatever the counter-question surfaced — «повторяю вопрос» plus a fact or option the side-dive added (e.g. operator asked "как ты делаешь ресёрч?" → the repeat pass adds an option «сначала ресёрч, потом решаем»); a verbatim repeat of the first gate carries no delta and is itself the violation. (c) if the operator answers the repeat pass with another counter-question instead of a pick, do not fire a third pass — stop and ask directly what is blocking the decision.
`QUESTION_FORMAT` is the base explain-then-ask discipline and its plain-text fallback; inside this protocol `AX_STAKES_SPLIT` specializes its batching rule into the развилка / default-confirmation split, and `QUESTION_MESSAGE_FORMAT` / `BATCH_CONFIRM_FORMAT` below specialize its message shape — neither contradicts it, both narrow it for the interview loop.
The map per `COVERAGE_MAP_FORMAT` opens every round — it is the operator's progress view, so keep it current and compact (per `AX_NO_PROCESS_NARRATION`, the map replaces narration about what the interview is doing).
Live coverage map, shown to the operator compactly before every round. Topic labels in Russian; ≤ 72 columns; statuses per `BREADCRUMB_FORMAT` — `✅` closed · `👷` in progress (the topic this round is closing) · `◻️` open — plus two map-only extensions: `✗ skip: <причина>` for a topic the operator explicitly waived, and `🟡` partial — the intake text already speaks to this topic, or one sub-category of a multi-part topic (e.g. one of the категории отказов) is addressed and the rest is not. `🟡` is NEVER a closure state: only a confirmed dialogue answer, or an explicit «принято как есть» note recorded in the spec, promotes a topic from `🟡` to `✅` (`AX_COVERAGE_MAP_CLOSURE`).
Покрытие: Цель/не-цель ✅ · Потребители 👷 · Слабые места ◻️ · Зависимости 🟡 · Категории отказов ◻️ Усиления: security 👷 · storage ✗ skip: прототип, данных нет
4–6 topics per line; the «Усиления» line appears only when at least one amplification is active or skipped. The map is ephemeral state for the current dialogue — the calling step decides what from the answers lands in the artifact; the map itself stays out of the spec.
The развилка message — one question, full context, live markdown (never fenced). Blocks in order; skip a block only when genuinely empty:
1. Coverage map line (`COVERAGE_MAP_FORMAT`). 2. `## Вопрос из · ` — X/Y per `AX_ONE_QUESTION_SEQUENTIAL`. 3. `**Решаем одной строкой:** `. 4. An ASCII diagram — only when the subject is relational (`AX_VISUAL_WHEN_RELATIONAL`). 5. `**📌 Что известно**` — 2–5 bullets, load-bearing words bold, specific to THIS question — not a restate of the session (`AX_SCANNABLE_TEXT`). 6. `**⚖️ Варианты**` — each variant: `**. **` then `✅ ` / `⚠️ `. 3+ variants with comparable criteria → a criteria×variant table INSTEAD of the lists (rows = criteria, columns = variants; the killer cell bold). 7. `**🎯 Куда клонюсь:** — ` — omit on high-stakes questions where pre-anchoring is wrong (`AX_DEFAULTS_FIRST`). 8. The `AskUserQuestion` call (`AX_ASK_TOOL_BINDING`) — options in printed order.
Покрытие: Цель/не-цель ✅ · Потребители ✅ · **формат спеки 👷** · Зависимости ◻️ · Слабые места ◻️
## Вопрос 3 из 6 · Куда переезжает разросшаяся ячейка Entity Inventory
**Решаем одной строкой:** ячейка таблицы с абзацем на восемь предложений не читается во вьювере — куда девать текст при миграции на v2-формат.
``` [ячейка: 8 предложений] ──migrate──► ??? ──рендер во вьювере──► [читаемая таблица] │ куда: подсекция? свернуть? урезать? ```
**📌 Что известно** - Правило F2 запрещает **абзацы и списки внутри ячейки** — только одна короткая строка. - Развёрнутый текст должен **переехать в подсекцию под таблицей**, а не исчезнуть. - `sdd-check` уже умеет **считать длину ячейки** — порог просто пока не задан.
**⚖️ Варианты**
**A. Короткая ячейка + подсекция `### — детали`** ✅ таблица остаётся индексом · ничего не теряется · механически проверяемо ⚠️ спека становится длиннее на число подсекций
**B. Урезать ячейку до одной фразы, остальное — в Decision Log** ✅ таблица короче любой подсекции ⚠️ решение теряет прямую связь со строкой таблицы — придётся искать отдельно
**🎯 Куда клонюсь:** A — подсекция держит связь «строка → детали», ничего не отрывается от таблицы.
(AskUserQuestion: «A. Подсекция под таблицей (рекомендую)» · «B. В Decision Log»)
Default confirmations — one compact block, then ONE `AskUserQuestion` call with 2–4 questions. Per item: one bold line (the default) + one plain line (the alternative and when it wins). No «Что известно» blocks, no diagrams. An item that provokes discussion is promoted to a развилка in the next message, not resolved inside the batch.
